name: 01-new-chat
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine ONLY the CHAT PAGE of Korean Salus personal meal service. Naming is now exactly "채팅", not "요리 찾기" and not a marketing home page. User accepted the existing login/purchase; use provided Salus screenshots as visual style references, NOT edit targets.
Take familiar interaction principles from leading conversational products: focus on composing, optional collapsed navigation, one conversation column, same composer moving to bottom during conversation. Make an ORIGINAL Salus UI, do not show competitor names/logos or copy their exact branding.
White canvas #FFFFFF, near-white #F4F5F4 utility surfaces, charcoal #252927, forest #30543D ONLY primary send/action. Lowercase sans salus wordmark, Korean SUIT-like humanist sans16px body, titles26-28px, normal readable weights. Comfortable20-24px pagepadding on mobile, desktop conversation width720px. One calm rounded composer16-20px corners because it is functional; not card-kit layouts.
STRICT: no food photos, food illustration/icons, mascots, decorative shape, gradient, AI sparkle, sidebar permanently open, right detail pane, multiple content columns, pill tool categories, model selector, microphone/voice/upload controls, invented capabilities, fake metrics or safety/source guarantees. No large marketing slogan or feature description. Never show the exact phrase "요리 찾기" ANYWHERE in these NEW screens, including menus and buttons. No serif headings.
Only active app destination name 채팅; other destinations 식사 기록, 내 레시피, 건강 정보 live in a CLOSED navigation drawer, not permanently visible top menu. Drawer functionality is signaled by standard hamburger only. Header shows hamburger, salus, small route name 채팅; right 새 채팅 and neutral user initials. Header not crowded. No visible sidebar or history list by default. Menu/history opens only on demand. Do not invent new search or pin capabilities. Past chat titles can live in the unopened drawer.
Recipes remain a compact object inside conversation, details open on demand in separate view. Keep unknown allergy state clear but show only once near a recommendation. No implication that all meals are safe. No source URLs are to be fabricated. Footer "생성된 정보는 확인이 필요하며 의료 조언이 아니에요." 
ONE full desktop screenshot1536x1024, no device frame, no mobile inset.
State: NEW CHAT / home-like entry, not landing. Header as specified, no sidebar. Tiny local 채팅 route label is visible, no current conversation title.
Main focus slightly above middle of screen, centered720px wide. Moderate28px friendly heading exactly "식사에 대해 무엇이 궁금하세요?" The whole design is not a huge greeting poster.
Under title one generous blank composer about720x120px with placeholder "식단, 재료, 먹은 음식에 대해 물어보세요." Text area is a softly outlined WHITE surface, subtle border, NO shadow/glow or extra labels repeated. Bottom-right small forest circular SEND arrow icon. No attachments, model dropdown, web tools or modes. Accessibility intent is labeled send but don't draw tooltip permanently.
Below composer plain small text link 건강 정보 입력. Three SMALL, QUIET example TEXT prompts in 2-3 readable rows, not cards, not a colored pill grid: "냉장고 재료로 저녁 추천해줘", "오늘 먹은 식사를 정리하고 싶어", "식사 습관에서 바꿀 점이 있을까?" Text should feel optional, not another feature panel. Plenty breathing room with functional focus.
Medical notice at true page bottom, subtle but legible. No 알레르기 alert banner in empty state; no safety judgment before a request. Do not add timestamps, calendar selection, recipe cards or fictional history. Keep simple familiar conversational first impression.
